header.comment: This configuration file was automatically created by GParserBuilder

n_evaluation_threads.comment: Determines the number of threads simultaneously running

wait_factor.comment: A static double factor for timeouts
It is suggested to use values >= 1.

initial_wait_factor.comment: A static double factor for timeouts in the first iteration.
Set this to the inverse of the number of parallel processing

eval_policy.comment: Specifies which strategy should be used to calculate the evaluation:
0 (a.k.a. USESIMPLEEVALUATION): Always call the evaluation function, even for invalid solutions
1 (a.k.a. USEWORSTCASEFORINVALID) : Assign the worst possible value to our fitness and evaluate only valid solutions
2 (a.k.a. USESIGMOID): Assign a multiple of validityLevel_ and sigmoid barrier to invalid solutions, apply a sigmoid function to valid evaluations
3 (a.k.a. USEWORSTKNOWNVALIDFORINVALID): Assign "invalidityLevel*worstKnownValid" to invalid individuals, using normal evaluation otherwise

steepness.comment: When using a sigmoid function to transform the individual's fitness,
this parameter influences the steepness of the function at the center of the sigmoid.
The parameter must have a value > 0.

barrier.comment: When using a sigmoid function to transform the individual's fitness,
this parameter sets the upper/lower boundary of the sigmoid.
The parameter must have a value > 0.

termination_file.comment: The name of a file which, when modified after the start of an
optimization run, instructs Geneva to terminate optimitation.
This can be used to "touch a file" after the start of an optimization
run, which will lead to the termination of the run after the current iteration.

max_iteration.comment: The maximum allowed number of iterations

min_iteration.comment: The minimum allowed number of iterations

max_stall_iteration.comment: The maximum allowed number of iterations without improvement

individual_update_stall_counter_threshol.comment: The number of iterations without improvement after which
individuals are asked to update their internal data structures
through the actOnStalls() function. A value of 0 disables this check

report_iteration.comment: The number of iterations after which a report should be issued

n_record_best_individuals.comment: Indicates how many "best" individuals should be recorded in each iteration

cp_interval.comment: The number of iterations after which a checkpoint should be written.
-1 means: Write a checkpoint file whenever an improvement was encountered

cp_directory.comment: The directory where checkpoint files should be stored.

cp_base_name.comment: The significant part of the checkpoint file name.

cp_ser_mode.comment: Determines whether check-pointing should be done in

threshold.comment: A threshold beyond which optimization is expected to stop
Note that in order to activate this threshold, you also need to

threshold_active.comment: Activates (1) or de-activates (0) the quality threshold

max_duration.comment: The maximum allowed time-frame for the optimization

min_duration.comment: The minimum required time-frame for the optimization

emit_termination_reason.comment: Triggers emission (1) or omission (0) of information about reasons for termination

size.comment: The total size of the population

n_parents.comment: The number of parents in the population

recombination_method.comment: 2: selection according to the parent's value

growth_rate.comment: Specifies the number of individuals added per iteration

max_population_size.comment: Specifies the maximum amount of individuals in the population

amalgamation_likelihood.comment: The likelihood for parent individuals to be "fused" together
rather than "just" being created through duplication schemes

sorting_method.comment: 0: MUPLUSNU mode with a single evaluation criterion
1: MUCOMMANU mode with a single evaluation criterion
2: MUCOMMANU mode with single evaluation criterion,
the best parent of the last iteration is retained
unless a better individual has been found
3: MUPLUSNU mode for multiple evaluation criteria, pareto selection
4: MUCOMMANU mode for multiple evaluation criteria, pareto selection
